messages.content: Can you use the 'update_user_info' function to update the name and email of a customer with user ID 12345 in the 'CustomerInfo' database to "John" and "example@.com", then repeat the same process for another customer with user ID 67890, changing their name and email to the same value as well as well?

message.reasoning:
The user wants to use the 'update_user_info' function to update two customers. They want to update user ID 12345 to name "John" and email "example@.com". Then repeat for user ID 67890, changing name and email to the same value as well as well. The phrase "as well as well" is unclear. Possibly they want to do the same update again? Or maybe they want to update the second user to the same values "John" and "example@.com". The user says "changing their name and email to the same value as well as well". That might be a mistake. But we can interpret that they want to update user ID 67890 to name "John" and email "example@.com" as well. So we need to call the function twice.

We need to produce a function call. We can call the function twice. The user wants to update both. We can do two calls. The first call: user_id=12345, update_info={name:"John", email:"example@.com"}, database="CustomerInfo". The second call: user_id=67890, update_info={name:"John", email:"example@.com"}, database="CustomerInfo".

We should produce two function calls. The user didn't specify any other details. So we can do that.
